options.name: arch
options.description: Target architecture for the package (e.g., 'x86-64' or 'aarch64'). If specified, will attempt to find a package matching this architecture. If not specified or if no architecture-specific package exists, will use the default package.

options.name: dest
options.description: Destination directory where the file should be saved.

options.name: state
options.description: Determines whether to download the latest version or a specific version.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for the HTTP request. This value sets both the connect and read timeouts.

options.name: url
options.description: Custom base URL to download Nexus from. If the URL ends with '.tar.gz', it will be used directly as the download URL. Otherwise, it will be used as a base URL to find package files. Can only be used when state is 'present' and version is defined. Version parameter is required if URL doesn't end with '.tar.gz'.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If False, SSL certificates will not be validated.

options.name: version
options.description: The version to download when state is 'present'.
